message.content:
An editorial illustration features a stylized man with brown skin, glasses, and grey hair standing on the right side. He wears a long-sleeved white button-down shirt, black pants with a silver buckle, and blue and white sneakers. His pants pockets are pulled out and empty. He holds an open, empty black wallet, with small white scraps and one pink banknote falling through the air around him. The text "Dahlan Iskan, Menteri BUMN" is positioned near his feet.

The background shows a large, yellow, arch-like structure with a central entrance labeled "RUANG RAPAT PARIPURNA." Large, bold text in the top center reads "JOKOWI DAN UNTUNG-RUGI MRT" above a larger red "TEMPO" logo. Smaller text below states "EDISI 5-11 NOVEMBER 2012." On the bottom left, black text reads "SIAPA PEMERAS BUMN." A barcode and pricing information, including "RP 29.700" and "WWW.TEMPO.CO," are at the bottom left. A solid red border runs along the left edge. The man is oriented toward the center, looking down at his wallet.
